_notes: UK 'Where will you be born?' part 1: the pin lands on Scunthorpe. Facts are real (AOL 1996 filter; 'Industrial Garden Town'; April 2025 Saturday recall of Parliament for British Steel; Keegan and Botham at Scunthorpe United); the banter is opinion.
cap: *bright*, !red!, #swear# (masked in captions, bleeped in the bleeped mix), {TEXT:N} replaces N spoken words.

lines.tts: Where in the UK are you gonna be born?
lines.cap: Where in the UK are you gonna be *born?*

lines.tts: Let's find out.
London?
Nah mate, you can't afford it.
Cornwall?
Too many bloody tourists.
Edinburgh?
Way too posh for you.
And you're getting born in...
Scunthorpe.
Oh, for fuck's sake.
Fact one. Your hometown has a swear word in its name.
lines.cap: *Fact* *one.* Your hometown has a !swear! !word! in its name.

lines.tts: In nineteen ninety-six, AOL wouldn't let anyone from Scunthorpe sign up, because the filter thought the whole bloody town was swearing at it.
lines.cap: In {1996,:2} AOL wouldn't let anyone from Scunthorpe sign up, because the filter thought the whole bloody town was !swearing! at it.

lines.tts: It's literally called the Scunthorpe problem.
Fact two. Its official nickname is the Industrial Garden Town.
That's like calling your wheelie bin a fucking water feature.
lines.cap: That's like calling your wheelie bin a #fucking# *water* *feature.*
lines.say: That's like calling your wheely-bin a fucking water feature.

lines.tts: Fact three. When the steelworks nearly shut in twenty twenty-five, Parliament got dragged in on a Saturday to save it.
lines.cap: *Fact* *three.* When the steelworks nearly shut in {2025,:2} Parliament got dragged in on a *Saturday* to save it.

lines.tts: Westminster gave up its weekend for Scunthorpe. That's the most love you'll ever get.
lines.cap: Westminster gave up its *weekend* for Scunthorpe. That's the most love you'll *ever* *get.*

lines.tts: Fact four. Kevin Keegan and Ian Botham both played for Scunthorpe United.
lines.cap: *Fact* *four.* Kevin Keegan and Ian Botham both played for Scunthorpe United.

lines.tts: Then they both left. Smart lads.
So that's you. Born in Scunthorpe. Tough shit, mate.
lines.cap: So that's you. Born in Scunthorpe. Tough #shit,# mate.

lines.tts: Where did yours land? Drop your town in the comments, and I'll roast it next.
lines.cap: Where did *yours* land? Drop your *town* in the comments, and I'll *roast* it *next.*
